review_pass_1.findings: Verified mitochondrial orientation, I/III/IV 4/4/2 and II non-pumping, signed Δp, c-ring/3, effective delivery costs, P/O oxygen-atom denominator, reversible motor, ADP states, inhibitor and AOX qualifications, illustrative experimental data. Recomputed PMF, redox energy, motor ratios, phosphorylation threshold, oxygen chamber normalization, route fractions and numerical question answers. Checked conceptual questions and revised vesicle and branching graphics.

review_pass_2.type: Separate internal editorial and static reader review
review_pass_2.findings: Compared 13,323 visible words with 6.A.06 exemplar (13,062); 135 unique narrative paragraphs, 18 coherent theory sections, 12 original diagrams and caption/zoom labels, 54 explained questions, 18 misconception analyses and revision glossary/14 recall prompts. Balanced option positions. Reader and dynamic adjacent-menu navigation inherited; no browser runtime test.

quality.basis: Internal rubric assessment; one mark deducted for limited independent source review, schematic SVG visual checks without rendering, some concise distractor explanations, lack of interactive accessibility testing, lack of browser runtime testing respectively.
